capabilities: display a cat sprite that chases the mouse cursor
make the cat curl up and sleep after a few seconds without mouse movement
disambiguation: Not a moon-phase, calendar, or theming plugin; despite the name it is a desktop cat that follows your cursor.
extras: Desktop only (needs a real cursor); installable from the community store, via BRAT, or by git clone; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's workspace is purely functional and offers no playful on-screen companion while you work.
summary: Desktop pet cat (a oneko port) that sits in Obsidian, chases the mouse cursor, and curls up to nap when you go idle.
